examples.text: Der kleine Hund hatte struwweliges Fell.

glosses: Of hair: in disarray, dishevelled, or unkempt.

examples.text: His shoes were covered with mud, and he was looking very rough and touzled; but then he had never been a very smart man, the Badger, at the best of times.
An instant later the maid, who looked as tousled and bewildered as if she had that instant been aroused from the deepest sleep, appeared with a card upon a tray.

glosses: simple past and past participle of tousle
